about.ngb.name: Name: %s
tooltip.ngb.bridgeEnabled: Enable formatting/filtering of bridge bot messages
tooltip.ngb.remoteBridgeEnabled: Send bridged messages to your website and receive replies back in-game
tooltip.ngb.remoteBridgeChannelId: Use different IDs for different servers/profiles
tooltip.ngb.remoteBridgePollMs: How often to check the backend for replies (250..10000)
tooltip.ngb.bridgeBotNames: Fallback list of bridge bot usernames (comma/space separated)
tooltip.ngb.blockList: If a bridged message contains one of these nicks/words, it will be hidden
tooltip.ngb.nickHighlightEnabled: Highlights your nickname in bridged guild messages
tooltip.ngb.senderNickColorEnabled: Recolors sender nickname without removing [LVL] and other prefixes
tooltip.ngb.senderNickLegacyEnabled: If enabled, sender nick will use Minecraft legacy formatting codes (e.g. §4§l)
tooltip.ngb.senderNickLegacyCodes: Example: §4§l (dark red + bold). Codes: §0-§f colors, §l bold, §o italic, §n underline, §m strike, §k magic, §r reset
tooltip.ngb.senderNickStyleOnlyMine: If enabled, nick styling applies only when sender nick equals your nickname
tooltip.ngb.myNickAliases: Extra names to treat as 'mine' (for visual nickname mods). Separate with commas
tooltip.ngb.telegramMarker: If message starts with this marker, it is treated as Telegram
tooltip.ngb.minecraftMarker: If message starts with this marker, it is treated as Minecraft (e.g. '.')
tooltip.ngb.wordHighlightEnabled: Highlights words in message text using rules below
tooltip.ngb.wordHighlightRules: Format: word=§codes; scam=§4§l; sale=§e. Separate rules with ';' or new lines
tooltip.ngb.wordHighlightOnlyMine: If enabled, word highlighting applies only when sender nick equals your nickname
tooltip.ngb.hideBotName: If enabled, bot name may be hidden when formatting
